svg.aria-label: Environment variables: SECRET_KEY — the site will not start without it; DEBUG — True — only on your own computer; ALLOWED_HOSTS — domains, separated by commas; DATABASE_URL — PostgreSQL; without it — local SQLite; USE_SPACES — True — photos are kept in DigitalOcean Spaces; DO_SPACES_* — Spaces key, secret, bucket and address
